Confidence STOPs lack an auto default

label: Auto and autopilot skip every applies_to: confirm block by rule, and the marker appears on 32 checkpoint blocks across the three files (7 plan, 11 implement, 14 complete).

The checkpoint skip costs the resolution branch, not the review text: implement step 4 has no route past an open P0 except the skipped option Address Blockers, and step 5 has no route past a failed environment check except the skipped option Hold, with no step-level failure action.

Eight step-level confidence_checkpoint blocks survive the skip because they are siblings of the checkpoint key, and seven end in wait_for user response, decision or resolution; no file defines a mode_overrides.auto section, only confirm.

Every confidence score is self-assessed: all eight confidence_checkpoint blocks phrase factors as questions to the same run and name no evaluator, then feed a threshold that either halts or authorises the next step.

An existing line can make a self-score checkable but not independent: only the conclusion-free plan explorers and the user-dispatched debug offer are other readers, and forcing each factor to cite the section it judged requires no new artifact.

Complete declares two gates at one location: the uninvoked quality_gates.planning_gate holds the only plan_has_approach and tasks_has_format checks, while the invoked phase_gate_checkpoint checks existence and NEEDS CLARIFICATION only.

direction: Counting every confirm-only checkpoint as a defect
reason: most duplicate a step-level activity that still runs; only two steps have no other exit
